say:1:1030228001:0.text: Don't you know? Lord Franz is in jail now. His Gemvine business is over. No more work for me, hooray!
say:1:1030228001:0.source_cn: 哦，你还不知道吧，弗朗茨老爷下大牢，藤水晶的生意完蛋了...

say:2:1030228002:0.text: Every day is a holiday. No task to perform. No alarm clock. This is the ultimate happiness!
say:2:1030228002:0.source_cn: 每天都是假期，什么都不用干，睡到自然醒，这才是绝顶的快乐！
